title: Sociaal-culturele ontwikkelingen in Nederland, 1979-1990,  SOCON 1979-1990
descriptions: This study is a compilation of variables from already existing studies: P0875, P1012 and P1100: Religion in Dutch Society 1979, 1985, 1990.Importance of career, money, family life, social security / importance of social equality and democracy / hedonism / the existence of God, the meaning of life, suffering and death / importance of religion to r.'s daily life and world view / attitude to trade unions, class differences and government intervention / restriction of civil liberties / family planning / abortion / euthanasia / suicide / view on women.Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ household characteristics/ occupation/employment/ education/ politics/ religion/ readership, mass media, and 'cultural' exposure/ organizational membership.The data- and documentation files of this dataset can be downloaded via the option Data Files.
